spanish: Y quitaré mi palma, y verás mi espalda, y mis faces no se verán.

findings.issue: H268 is a masculine plural construct (hinder parts) with a 1cs suffix; espalda is singular and changes number.

notes: Quitar (hiphil 1cs), palma (fs), verás (qal 2ms), faces (plural), and no se verán (niphal 3mp) match the other tokens.
